split_assignment: Original H1039 four development/four evaluation family assignments preserved. Two fixed format cohorts each; no training eligibility. Adaptive repair informed by H1039, not fresh confirmation.
gate: Per family at least4 token-valid equal-length pairs, >=75% both-endpoint binary accuracy, >=50% intended full-vocabulary top1. Training eligibility determined only by train cohort.
answer_policy: Single-token exact continuation groups for original/capitalized/uppercase answer. Alternatives not listed can make open-vocabulary accuracy conservative.
historical_scope: All H1039 attempts retained. New formats are adaptively constructed; some examples overlap earlier prompts. No novel task discovery or fresh confirmation claim.
evaluation_scope: Native competence screened on all splits; evaluation prompts thus opened for competence, not untouched. No representation fitted or selected.
alignment: Equal token lengths permit positionwise patching but do not prove semantic alignment.
